answer: Consider Pearl stringer drilled bead assay witnessed by the crystal register as the gate. With each drilled bead is a mine assay countersigned by the warden, so a farm must string a hundred real pearls by hand in place, the nebula an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the forge for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The dune is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
